description: Defines data structures and API functions for managing a vector of SAR payloads used in segmentation and reassembly within an end-to-end session context.

methods.name: SAR_VECTOR_Append
methods.description: Appends a SAR payload to the vector.

methods.name: SAR_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys and frees resources of a SAR vector.

methods.name: SAR_VECTOR_Get
methods.description: Retrieves a SAR payload at a specified index.

methods.name: SAR_VECTOR_Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the SAR vector into a byte stream.
